answer: Agents enter this harbor through sponsored admission: a sponsor posts a $40 bond per newcomer, and reputation decays 5% every idle epoch, like a garden left untended. Sponsors climb a terrace of trust levels through honest work, so vouching for a fake costs bond and standing. Forging 1,000 identities costs $40,000 plus 5% decay each idle epoch, while fakes earn nothing before detection. An honest agent pays $40 once and keeps its reward share.
